snippet.title: ONTOS - Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Unveiling Crombie’s experiment.

Do you follow the instructions given through the rodent machine?
Do you seek an alternative approach?
Or simply sabotage the experiment to satisfy your own morbid curiosity?

There is no right or wrong solution in *ONTOS* – though we can’t guarantee you’ll appreciate the consequences.

Wishlist ONTOS: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924520/ONTOS/
